headline: Marina Park West Lot parking expansion and Narrow River boat ramp reconstruction at Mitchell and Pollock Ave.
summary: Topics include a Marina Park and Town Farm Park master plan and a possible salt marsh restoration at Succotash Marsh. Public access to the water at Washington Street in Matunuck is also on the list.
items: Narragansett and Charlestown Harbor Commission agenda and minutes
CRMC public notice for pier replacement in Narragansett, file 2026-08-078
Online GIS map of South Kingstown rights of way to the shore
Public right-of-way access at Washington Street site in Matunuck, Segar Cove, under Boats and Waterways Ordinance 4-14
Coastal road and right-of-way survey, and Charlestown Beach Road survey status
Expansion of parking lot at Marina Park West Lot
Marina Park and Town Farm Park master plan, with connection to downtown Wakefield
Former leased waterfront area along Saugatucket River next to Marina Park, returning to town operations July 1, 2027
Reconstruction of RIDEM Narrow River boat ramp at Mitchell and Pollock Ave
Possible salt marsh restoration at RIDEM Succotash Marsh Management Area
location: The Neighborhood Guild, 325 Columbia St., Peace Dale, RI
